connector.name: TensorFeed
connector.registryDescription: AI news, model pricing, service status, and machine-payable premium tools. AFTA-certified.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.tensorfeed.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace ai.tensorfeed, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TENSORFEED_TOKEN
env.description: Bearer token from /api/payment/buy-credits. Required for paid tiers (full verdicts, 8 to 90 day series, webhook watches, account status). Free tiers (news, status, pricing, verdict previews, 1 to 7 day series, model discovery) work without it. Buy credits in USDC on Base at https://tensorfeed.ai/developers/agent-payments.
